message: Independent read-only review complete at 8d3f7a285 against 322f30343. One important P2 compatibility/correctness finding: file_facts.sql:72 hardcodes main for layout detection. Pinned DuckDB 2.0.0 in-memory reproduction shows non-main no-op refreshing all keys; with an intact main layout, missing facts.file_facts_edges is recreated empty with refresh=0 (actual 0 vs full-UNNEST 3). Baseline repairs it. Request parent correction before integration. No other important/critical findings; no separate minor findings. Recorded RED/GREEN logs, artifact/source hashes, unchanged original tests and prefix/suffix, independent oracle, and finite POST witnesses verified. No source/file edits, builds, suite reruns, commits, merges or issue closes. Parent benchmark remains outstanding; no speedup claimed.

evidence.constraints: No source edits/fixes/commits/builds/merge/close. Only ephemeral :memory: engine reproduction and read-only inspection; no snapshot publication. Canonical PM audit and risk signal are the requested collaboration record.

important_findings.title: Scope child-layout detection to the schema of the maintained relations
important_findings.cause: The duckdb_tables() predicate requires schema_name='main', while all unqualified CREATE/DELETE/INSERT statements use the active schema. The previous SQL had no main-only restriction.
reproduction: Use pinned Python/DuckDB 2.0.0 and approved native extension; :memory: connection, SET temp_directory='', threads=2. Execute production SQL through COMMIT only, omitting all COPY statements; no files are written.

CREATE SCHEMA facts; SET schema='facts'; create staged_sources(blob_oid VARCHAR,logical_path VARCHAR,source VARCHAR,extractor_sha VARCHAR), source_lineage(blob_oid VARCHAR,logical_path VARCHAR,extractor_sha VARCHAR). Stage ('blob','lib.rs','fn helper() {} fn main() { helper(); }','v1'). Run twice.
Second run: bootstrap=true, refresh=1, extracted=0; expected no-op refresh=0.
SET schema='main'; create equivalent staging and lineage tables, stage the same row and run once so main has an intact six-table layout.
SET schema='facts'; DROP TABLE facts.file_facts_edges; rerun the same production prefix.
Observed bootstrap=false, refresh=0, extracted=0, file_facts_edges count=0, full-cache sum(len(facts.edges))=3. Subsequent no-ops retain the missing edge rows because checkpoint already covers C.
A separate :memory: run of baseline 322f30343 in facts repairs a dropped edge table and returns actual/reference counts (3,3).
important_findings.impact: Violates no-op/refresh contract outside main; another schema's intact layout can suppress mandatory missing-child repair and silently lose the derived child collection.
important_findings.suggested_resolution: Use the schema/catalog of the actual target cache/checkpoint/children consistently for metadata detection and add a multi-schema missing-child/no-op regression; no fixes made in this review.

semantics_review.established_layout: Refresh UNION is distinct (C-S) UNION M; removed=S-C; invalidated refresh UNION removed. All joins/deletes use blob_oid,logical_path,extractor_sha.
semantics_review.bootstrap: Correct all-C cache-driven refresh and full child deletion for main layout, including orphan cleanup when state is absent; schema-scope exception R1.
semantics_review.no_op: Main layout preserves physical tables via IF NOT EXISTS and materializes only refresh facts; no all-payload hash present.
semantics_review.statuses: NULL/error/empty parents checkpointed through key sets regardless of child count; full child oracle covers all statuses.
semantics_review.retry_delete: M forces replacement when final C and S both still contain retried key; deletion without restaging produces removed keys and not_cached lineage.
semantics_review.native_fields_types_ordinals: Each original node.*,edge.*,span.*,invocation.*,macro_scope.* projection and per-list WITH ORDINALITY retained. Full-cache EXCEPT ALL both ways and DESCRIBE validate fields/types/order, without reproducing delta algorithm.
semantics_review.lineage: Unconditional source_lineage LEFT JOIN cache retains duplicate/root/merge occurrence multiplicity independently of child deltas.
semantics_review.transaction: BEGIN before cache mutations; checkpoint/all children/occurrences before COMMIT; cache extraction prefix and caller-lineage/COMMIT/seven-export suffix byte-equal to baseline.
semantics_review.exports: Exactly seven unchanged COPY statements follow COMMIT. Full snapshot publication cost/non-atomic behavior retained.
